name: PGC 13294 (Hubble)
blurb: PGC 13294, a nearby galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: pgc13294-hubble
story: Hubble photographed PGC 13294 as part of a survey of nearby galaxies, measuring distances from their brightest red giant stars to map the local universe in three dimensions.

claims.text: PGC 13294 is a target of Hubble program 13442, 'The Geometry and Kinematics of the Local Volume'
Program 13442 targets nearby galaxies drawn from a complete sample of unobscured galaxies in the Local Volume
Program 13442 measures distances to nearby galaxies with the tip of the red giant branch
Program 13442 uses the distances to build three-dimensional maps of galaxies
